revision.content: == I. Called to order at on July 11th, 2026 == === A. Kevin Ratcliff, Kyle Dirrim (Secretary), Nathan Heald, Susan Sons (Officer), Adam Nuwer, Jimmy Torres (Treasurer), Samuel Bowman, Adam Ploshay, Joeseph Czeslich (President), LaserDan, Jenett Tillotson, Jason, Sam, Pete Kinne (Officer), Adam === === B. 14 Members in attendance, quorum achieved === == II. Old Business == === A. Motion to charge the 2026-2027 Board to investigate whether the above or another new financial infrastructure for Bloominglabs is viable; to effect the new infrastructure, if so; regardless of viability, report back to the membership the results of the investigation on or before 2026JUL01. === === B. Motion to charge the board with reevaluating dues with the goal of raising rates to at least correct for inflation and fully cover recurring costs, to be presented to the membership by July 31 2026? === ==== 1. slide 2: dues have not kept up wtih inflation ==== ==== 2. slide 3: membership breakdown ==== ===== a. 32 Class A members ===== ===== b. 17 Class B members ===== ==== 3. slide 4: budget breakdown ==== ==== 4. slide 5: in the red ==== ==== 5. slide 6: losing $1065/month ==== ===== a. Have lost 3 members ===== ====== i. two passed away ====== ===== b. misc. is reimbuirsments to members, unable to track fully ===== ==== 6. slide 7: Blabs could be kaput by December 2026 ==== ==== 7. slide 9: Proposal breakdown ==== ===== a. raise all membership rates by $30 ===== ====== i. Implemented September 1st ====== ===== b. no grandfathering in old rates ===== ===== c. require 6 hours volunteer hours from Class II memberships ===== ====== i. no one knows when/who added “hardship rate” checkbox to membership form ====== ^.will be taken off ====== ii. will people be able to do them ====== ====== iii. alternative: we collect financial information, gross ====== ====== iv. alternative: “scholarship fund” for Class II members, would require bylaws change ====== ====== v. number of hours is negotiable ====== ====== vi. asking members to ask the board for Class II rate is a concentration of responsibility ====== ^. currently any member can veto potential members ====== vii. can members buy their way out of volunteer hours ====== ^. members could bank hours ^. accounting for money for this is only marginally harder ====== viii. adding volunteer labor slack channel to default slack channels ====== ====== ix. self-reporting of capabilities for volunteer tasks ====== ===== d. enforce rules about non-payers ===== ====== i. slightly more likely to be Class B memberships ====== ===== e. $3360/year income vs $2995/year expenses ===== ====== i. $365/month in the black for the first year ====== ===== f. 97 door fobs for 49 members ===== ==== 8. slide 10: Migrating to QuickBooks ==== ===== a. better autopay ===== ===== b. slightly cheaper processing fees ===== ===== c. much cheaper subscription costs ===== ==== 9. slide 11: other suggestions: ==== ===== a. clarify reimbursement policy ===== ===== b. selling surplus tools/materials ===== ===== c. revenue through workshops ===== ===== d. donations ===== ===== e. grants ===== ====== i. cannot fulfill accounting requirements ====== ====== ii. which grants align with community values? ====== ====== iii. should start finding/researching grants now ====== ==== 10. slide 12: recap ==== === C. Brief recess from 1440 to 1445 === === D. MOTION: to raise membership rates to $80 for Class I members and $55 for Class II members on September 01st 2026? === ==== 1. seconded ==== ==== 2. Have we reached adequate consesnsus? ==== ===== a. apparently so ===== ==== 2. the board did not have time/resources to create a perfect survey ==== ==== 3. amount of adjustment ==== ===== a. culture dictates keeping membersip rates low ===== ===== b. blabs is a high value for cost ===== ==== 4. AMMENDMENT: ammend motion from “$55 for Class II members” to “$40 for Class II members” and propose board investigate hardship rates before the next annual meeting? ==== ===== a. seconded ===== ===== b. how does that change financial state? ===== ====== i. two years of solvency instead of three ====== ==== 5. AMMENDMENT: To raise the full membership rate to 80 USD/mo as of Sept 1, 2026, To authorize the board to raise the hardship rate to at least 40 USD/mo, and at most 55 USD/mo by Sept 1, 2026, And to require the board to include information on the viability of membership rates in the report at every annual member meeting hereafter. ==== ===== a. seconded ===== ===== b. Jenett has volunteered to contact Class II members to guage ability to bear potential rate increase ===== ===== c. VOTE: 11 ayes, 0 nays, 2 abstentions ===== ===== d. MOTION PASSES ===== === E. MOTION: To charge the board with proposing, at the next annual member meeting, a process for the review of hardship memberships. === ==== 1. VOTE: Unanimously passes ==== == III. adjourned at 1554 on 2026-07-11 ==
